MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My recent purchases solved specific connection needs for computers and peripherals. Streaming players, voice assistants, smart displays and a camera do not address a need I currently have.",
    "The earbuds and speaker resemble my old headset purchase only broadly. That purchase does not mean I currently need replacement headphones or another way to play audio.",
    "Memory cards could be useful with the right device, but I have no identified storage need, so neither the single card nor the two-pack gives me a reason to buy."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronic accessories seems to have been treated as interest in electronic gadgets generally, although the practical purpose of each purchase matters to me.",
    "One older headset purchase seems to have been stretched into ongoing interest in audio products, without a current reason for me to choose them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest purchase was a USB-to-Ethernet adapter, following earlier Wi-Fi, USB expansion and display cable purchases. Those choices point toward solving particular connectivity problems.",
    "My interactions are infrequent and spread across years. I need a clear practical use before choosing another accessory; a related past purchase alone is not enough.",
    "Compatibility matters for the accessories I have chosen. A useful suggestion would need to fit an actual device or connection need, rather than merely be another electronic product."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions interpreted my occasional, practical accessory purchases as broad gadget interest, leaving me with no compelling next choice."
}
